en.settings.cacheSecHint: Default 40 s; keep below the card refresh interval
en.settings.cc.ark.hint: Queries Agent Plan quota (5h/weekly/monthly). Create AK/SK at console.volcengine.com → Access Control → API Access Keys; these are a different pair from the HUOSHAN_API_KEY dsh models use.
en.settings.cc.claude.hint: Queries 5h session / 7-day weekly official quota and reset countdowns. No extra credentials required; automatically reuses the CPA base URL from Network settings via the Nginx quota cache endpoint.
en.settings.cc.cmd.hint: Queries 5h/weekly/monthly usage. Get the API key in your commandcode.ai account settings.
en.settings.cc.cpa.hint: Queries the 5h/weekly remaining quota. Both credentials come from your CPA server (nginx Basic is the second lock, the CPA management key the third); the plugin reads the quota probed by the antigravity-priority plugin.
en.settings.cc.deepseek.tokenHint1: What it is: the session token of the DeepSeek website (platform.deepseek.com). The API key only queries the balance; the today/7d/30d spend requires this web token against the official usage API.
en.settings.cc.deepseek.tokenHint2: How to get it: sign in at platform.deepseek.com → press F12 to open DevTools → Console tab → paste and run JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('userToken')).value → copy the long string it prints.
en.settings.cc.deepseek.tokenHint3: What it does: paste it below and save; the plugin writes it into ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml through the official credentials service, and the card shows real official usage (instead of a balance-delta estimate). Note: it is a web session and expires (official code 40002/40003); when it does, the card warns and you re-paste a fresh token here.
en.settings.cc.intro: Credentials each channel needs to show its balance/usage. Rows marked "DSH model config" are already configured in dsh models and are read-only; the rest are entered here and saved through the official credentials service.
en.settings.cpaBaseUrlHint: Your own CLIProxyAPI management address for Google AI Pro and Claude Pro quotas (empty = not queried; e.g. https://cpa.example.com)
en.settings.cpaStaleSecHint: A CPA snapshot older than this counts as stale and the plugin requests a fresh probe automatically (default 1200 s; keep it above CPA-side scheduling, e.g. 15 min)
en.settings.credentialFileHint: Credentials document filename (relative to DSH home); default .credentials.yaml
en.settings.dangerThresholdHint: Bar turns red at this used %
en.settings.intro: Configure the sidebar balance card display and refresh behaviour. Changes apply immediately after saving (a few after restart).
en.settings.pollSecHint: Default 60 s, matching DeepSeek official cadence
en.settings.readonly: Settings document is not writable (read-only environment).
en.settings.showCardHint: Turning this off hides all channel cards
en.settings.timeoutSecHint: Volcano Ark / Command Code / DeepSeek official usage request timeout
en.settings.title: Balance Monitor
en.settings.warnThresholdHint: Bar turns amber at this used %
en.tip.estimate: Today is a balance-delta estimate; 7d/30d unavailable
en.tip.tokenExpired: Official usage token expired — update DEEPSEEK_PLATFORM_TOKEN in the settings page
